blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala has arrived in China for the upcoming Wuhan Open, marking her return to the WTA Tour. Photos from the official tournament Instagram showed Eala hitting the practice court on Thursday. READ: Alex Eala tells Sharapova she has ‘capacity to suffer’ as she chases ‘crush’ The World No. 18 Eala is projected as the 13th seed in the WTA 1000 tournament, which is part of the Asian swing. The projected top five seeds are Aryna Sabalenka, Jessica Pegula, Mirra Andreeva, Linda Noskova and Elina Svitolina.
